purpose: Bridge Solvency II technical provisions (best estimate + risk margin) to IFRS 17 insurance contract liabilities (fulfilment cash flows + risk adjustment + CSM). Computes bridge_delta and flags when the relative gap exceeds 10% of SII provisions. Compares risk adjustment against SII risk margin using EIOPA research benchmarks (RA typically 33-44% lower than risk margin for life insurance, FSI Insights 26). Feeds insurance reporting readiness diagnostic (art-182). Zero network, zero PII.
